system.description: A stand-alone Celestial Martial Arts Charm that may only be learned by Celestial Exalted and akuma. Every three experience points (or three bonus points at character creation) allocated to a Terrestrial Martial Arts style provides two Charms from that style instead of one. The character also no longer needs to pay a surcharge when using elementally aspected Terrestrial MA styles. Should the character already know Terrestrial MA Charms when learning this Charm, their XP cost is retroactively lowered and the difference is refunded.
